name: us.shprd.mcp/bible
title: Shprd Bible
description: Read, search and quote the World English Bible, with a reader card and a verse of the day.

tools.name: get_bible_passage
tools.description: Returns the exact text of a Bible passage in the World English Bible (WEB), with a WEB credit. The WEB's wording differs from other translations (for example its John 3:16 says "only born Son"). Use this when the user asks to quote a passage or give the words, or the exact text is needed to answer a question, for example "John 3:16", "Psalm 23" or "1 Corinthians 13:4-7". Up to 200 verses per call; a longer range stops there and says how to continue. It returns a known passage by reference; it does not search by words and does not provide other translations.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verses, e.g. "John 3:16", "John 3:16-18", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:28-9:3", "Jude 5".

tools.name: search_bible
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find verses by words or a phrase in the World English Bible, for example "where does it say 'love your enemies'" or "verses about shepherd in Psalms". Matches whole words and word beginnings of up to 8 distinct words (words under 2 letters and extras are ignored); every word must appear, otherwise verses with most of the words are returned and marked some_words. Results are WEB wording only, so a phrase from another translation may not match. Returns up to `limit` verses and the total count. It finds verses; it does not return a passage by reference.

query.description: Words or a phrase to find, e.g. "love your enemies".

book.description: Optional book to search within, e.g. "Psalms" or "1 John".

limit.description: Number of verses to return (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: list_bible_books
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which books the Bible has, how many chapters a book has, or you need a book's canonical code or name. Lists all 66 books in canonical order with testament and chapter count. It does not return Bible text.

tools.name: list_bible_chapters
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many chapters a Bible book has or where each chapter ends, or you need valid chapter and verse numbers before reading. Takes a book name and lists each chapter with its last verse number in the World English Bible (the WEB omits a few verses, so this can exceed the number of verses printed). It does not return Bible text.

book.description: Book name, abbreviation or code, e.g. "Romans", "1 Cor" or "PSA".

tools.name: get_shprd_beliefs
tools.description: Returns Shprd's published statement of what it holds: the essentials of the Christian faith it affirms with the Nicene Creed, and the list of matters where faithful Christians differ and Shprd presents each view. Use this when the user asks what Shprd believes, what Shprd's position or statement of faith is, or how Shprd handles a question of doctrine. It is Shprd's own statement, not Bible text and not a ruling on any tradition. It does not read or search the Bible.

tools.name: get_verse_of_the_day
tools.description: Returns Shprd's verse of the day in the World English Bible: one verse (or a short passage) chosen for each calendar day, the same one the Shprd app shows. Use this when the user asks for the verse of the day, today's verse, a daily verse, or a verse to start the morning. Pass the user's local date as `date` when you know it; without it, today in UTC is used. Dates more than a few days from today get a verse from a fixed rotation. Returns the reference, the exact WEB text and the credit; in hosts with cards it also shows the verse in the Shprd reader card. It does not look up a specific passage and does not search.

date.description: The calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-20". Omit for today (UTC).

tools.name: open_bible_reader
tools.description: Reads a Bible passage or chapter from the World English Bible. Use this when the user asks to read, open, show or look up a passage, for example "read Romans 8", "open Matthew 9" or "show me Psalm 23". In ChatGPT the passage appears in a reader card with previous and next chapter buttons and the source credit, and only the reference and credit are returned as text. In other clients it returns the passage text and credit, and a client that can draw the card shows it too. It does not search by words.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verses, e.g. "John 3:16-18", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:28-9:3", "Jude 5".
